event.title: Liverpool Secures Draw Against Nottingham Forest in Iraola's Anfield Debut
event.canonical_title: Liverpool Secures Draw Against Nottingham Forest in Iraola's Anfield Debut
event.summary: Victor Munoz scored a late goal to help Liverpool secure a 2-2 draw against Nottingham Forest in the Premier League. The match marked the Anfield debut of coach Iraola, with Liverpool coming from behind twice to avoid defeat.
